scope: One finite software-simulation-only joint-position step with real controller/state confirmation
required_intersection: fresh named joint state with finite radians
native completion and observable state confirmation
explicitly_unsupported: physical robot operation in these fixtures
coupled-joint or mimic mapping without a reviewed lossless bounded mapping
completion inferred solely from topic publish or goal acceptance
DDS security or TLS inferred merely from ROS release
outside_wasm: platform selection and official simulator/driver version
ROS release/Linux ABI/RMW/transport and security configuration
native resource names and explicit grants
joint-name permutation/sign/zero offset and radians-to-microradians mapping
frame declarations, limits, calibration, timing/freshness policy and acknowledgement witness
adapter_requirements: Only a bijection between dense slots and distinct named joints, with finite declared bounds and units; duplicate/missing slots or names are refused
Policy grants are separate deployment inputs tied to exact Wasm SHA, Instance, adapter hash, mapping epoch and native resource provenance; adapter JSON cannot grant
Native endpoint/controller mismatch, inactive controller, stale state, unauthorized resource, unsupported semantics and mapping changes fail explicitly
Keep generated-chain checked unwind, crash recovery, paired unwind headers, cache/source/module provenance and permission checks in every process
Formal evidence records the same complete Wasm SHA before/after all platforms; no recompilation, relink, source-equality or host-precomputed answer can substitute
Official fake hardware demonstrates its documented software command/state scope, not dynamics, payload/contact safety or real hardware

identity_rules.mapping_sha256: SHA256 of the exact bounded UTF-8 adapter JSON file bytes, including whitespace/final newline; do not reserialize before hashing
identity_rules.policy_sha256: SHA256 of the exact separately supplied deployment policy bytes; adapter/schema/source metadata never grants
identity_rules.algorithm_sha256: SHA256 of the entire immutable .wasm file; not source identity, ELF digest or cache-domain key
identity_rules.configuration_limits: Adapter <=32768 bytes, strict UTF-8, no duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, NUL names or nonfinite numbers
identity_rules.epoch: Nonzero owner-local generation bound to exact mapping and permission digests; changes invalidate stale handles/commands, including debug/hot-update/rollback paths

ros2_jtc_semantics.admission: Exact mapped joint set must match the active official controller's claimed interfaces; no implicit partial-joint goal or coupled-joint approximation
ros2_jtc_semantics.submit: A single native FollowJointTrajectory goal with exact UUID and transformed full joint vector; acceptance -> portable ACCEPTED only
ros2_jtc_semantics.completion: Native SUCCEEDED plus FollowJointTrajectory result SUCCESSFUL and a fresh mapped JointState within canonical tolerance -> portable SUCCEEDED
ros2_jtc_semantics.observability: Retain full native goal/result/status and independent state witness tied to portable command SHA, owner, epoch, module SHA and real official node/plugin identities
ros2_jtc_semantics.tolerances: Do not translate canonical tolerance into a native 'erased/unrestricted' value; canonical post-state comparison remains mandatory
ros2_jtc_semantics.time: Freshness is host monotonic receipt time; ROS /clock pause or rewind never manufactures a new sample

actual_artifact_and_qualification_status: Read separately versioned artifact receipts; this source contract never upgrades itself to runtime PASS
